questions.prompt: Choose the best response. All objects in cabinet P are metal. No metal object in the workshop is transparent. Which conclusion must be true?

choices.A: No object in cabinet P is transparent.
choices.B: Some transparent objects are in cabinet P.
choices.C: Every metal object is in cabinet P.

questions.correctAnswer: No object in cabinet P is transparent.
questions.explanation: Because every cabinet-P object is metal and no workshop metal object is transparent, none of those objects is transparent.

questions.prompt: Choose the best response. Four exhibits—W, X, Y, and Z—open on consecutive days. X opens before W. Z opens immediately after W. Y opens before X. Which exhibit opens third?
questions.explanation: The only order satisfying all constraints is Y, X, W, Z.

questions.prompt: Choose the best response. A code is approved only if it contains a digit and ends with K. Code R contains a digit but does not end with K. What must be true?

choices.B: Every unapproved code lacks a digit.
choices.D: Code R contains exactly one digit.

questions.explanation: Ending with K is necessary for approval, so a code lacking that ending cannot be approved.

questions.prompt: Every manuscript in the cabinet is cataloged. No cataloged item may leave the archive. Which conclusion must be true?

choices.D: The cabinet may leave the archive.

questions.prompt: Four flags—J, K, L, and M—hang in a row. J is immediately left of K. M is left of J. L is not at either end. Which flag is first?
questions.explanation: The block M-J-K must occur in that order; with L not at an end, only M can be first.

questions.prompt: Exactly two of Ana, Bo, and Cy attend. If Ana attends, Bo does not. If Cy does not attend, Ana attends. Which pair could attend?
questions.explanation: Bo and Cy satisfies exactly two attendees and does not violate either conditional rule.
